scenarios.title: A｜预订没有成功
scenarios.setting: 在“预订出现问题 Booking Problems”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“预订没有成功”。

turns.text: Good afternoon, Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I tried to make a reservation on your website, but I don’t think it went through.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I tried to make a reservation on your website, but I don’t think it went through.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Hi, I tried to book a room online, but I’m not sure if the booking was successful.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I tried to book a room online, but I’m not sure if the booking was successful.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I was trying to make a reservation, but I didn’t get a confirmation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was trying to make a reservation, but I didn’t get a confirmation.
feedback.explanation: “I was trying to”交代当时正在尝试的操作，适合解释故障发生在哪一步。

choices.text: I booked online, but maybe it didn’t success.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I tried to make a reservation on your website, but I don’t think it went through.
feedback.explanation: “success”是名词，“successful”是形容词，不能直接跟在“didn’t / can’t”后作动词；这里可说“didn’t go through”。

turns.text: I can check that for you. Did you receive a confirmation email?

turns.prompt: 你想确认办理结果或确认信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, I didn’t receive any confirmation email.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I didn’t receive any confirmation email.
feedback.explanation: “confirmation email”指确认邮件，用来核对办理结果。

choices.text: No, that’s why I’m calling.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, that’s why I’m calling.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: No. I completed the booking, but I never got a confirmation.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. I completed the booking, but I never got a confirmation.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: No, I didn’t received anything.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I didn’t receive any confirmation email.
feedback.explanation: “didn’t”已经表示过去，后面的动词用原形，不再用过去式；例如“didn’t receive”。

turns.text: All right. May I have the name and email address you used for the booking?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. The booking should be under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. The booking should be under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: I used the name Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I used the name Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “I used”交代之前采用的信息或方法，便于对方核对记录。

choices.text: It should be under the name Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: It should be under the name Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under the name”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: My booking should under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. The booking should be under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “should”后需要动词，“预订在某人名下”可以说“should be under + 姓名”，不能省去“be”。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but I don’t see a completed reservation under that name.

turns.prompt: 你想确认预订是否成功，会怎么说？

choices.text: So the reservation didn’t go through?

feedback.naturalExpression: So the reservation didn’t go through?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Does that mean my room wasn’t booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does that mean my room wasn’t booked?
feedback.explanation: “does that mean”根据刚得到的信息核对含义，给对方纠正理解的机会。

choices.text: So I don’t have a reservation right now?

feedback.naturalExpression: So I don’t have a reservation right now?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: So my reservation didn’t successful?

feedback.naturalExpression: So the reservation didn’t go through?
feedback.explanation: “success”是名词，“successful”是形容词，不能直接跟在“didn’t / can’t”后作动词；这里可说“didn’t go through”。

turns.text: That’s correct. It looks like the booking wasn’t completed.

turns.prompt: 你想请前台协助重新完成预订，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Can I make the reservation with you now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Can I make the reservation with you now?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: In that case, I’d like to book the room now.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, I’d like to book the room now.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: Are the same dates and room type still available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are the same dates and room type still available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Then can you help me book it again?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Can I make the reservation with you now?
feedback.explanation: 这句本身可以使用；“make the reservation with you now”更明确是请当前接线员直接完成预订。

turns.text: Certainly. Let me check availability for you.

scenarios.title: B｜支付失败
scenarios.setting: 在“预订出现问题 Booking Problems”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“支付失败”。

turns.text: Grand Park Hotel. How may I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「预订出现问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m trying to book a room online, but my payment keeps failing.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m trying to book a room online, but my payment keeps failing.
feedback.explanation: “keeps failing”说明操作反复失败，区别于偶尔一次出错。

choices.text: Hi, I tried to pay for my reservation, but the payment didn’t go through.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I tried to pay for my reservation, but the payment didn’t go through.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I’m having trouble paying for my booking.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m having trouble paying for my booking.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: My payment can’t success.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m trying to book a room online, but my payment keeps failing.
feedback.explanation: “success”是名词，“successful”是形容词，不能直接跟在“didn’t / can’t”后作动词；这里可说“didn’t go through”。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. Are you seeing an error message?

turns.prompt: 关于「预订出现问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. It says, “Payment declined.”

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It says, “Payment declined.”
feedback.explanation: “payment declined”表示支付被拒，具体指出失败发生在付款环节。

choices.text: Yes, it says my payment was declined.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it says my payment was declined.
feedback.explanation: “payment was declined”表示支付被拒，具体指出失败发生在付款环节。

choices.text: Yes, but it doesn’t explain why.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, but it doesn’t explain why.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: Yes, it says my card can’t pay.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It says, “Payment declined.”
feedback.explanation: “my card can’t pay”把支付失败说成卡片在付款；复述“Payment declined”等实际提示更便于排查。

turns.text: Have you checked that your card information is correct?

turns.prompt: 你想确认信息或告诉对方已经完成，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, I’ve checked it twice, and the information is correct.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’ve checked it twice, and the information is correct.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve checked”说明已核查过，帮助对方了解哪些步骤已经完成。

choices.text: Yes. The card number and expiration date are correct.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. The card number and expiration date are correct.
feedback.explanation: “expiration date”指有效期截止日期，核对卡片或证件时常用。

choices.text: I think so. Let me check again.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think so. Let me check again.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Yes, I already check it two times.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’ve checked it twice, and the information is correct.
feedback.explanation: 已完成的检查要用过去式或完成时；“twice”比“two times”更简洁，如“I’ve checked it twice”。

turns.text: In that case, the payment may have been declined by your bank.

turns.prompt: 你想在支付失败后尝试其他付款方式，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I try a different card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I try a different card?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Do you accept other payment methods?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you accept other payment methods?
feedback.explanation: “payment methods”指可用的付款方式，先确认是否接受再支付更顺畅。

choices.text: Is there another way I can pay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another way I can pay?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Can I change another card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I try a different card?
feedback.explanation: 换用另一张卡通常说“try a different card / use another card”，不说“change another card”。

turns.text: Yes. You can try another credit or debit card.

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Will I be charged for the failed payment attempt?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Will I be charged for the failed payment attempt?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Just to make sure, I haven’t been charged yet, right?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just to make sure, I haven’t been charged yet, right?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Could you check whether any payment went through?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether any payment went through?
feedback.explanation: “payment went through”谈支付或申请时表示成功处理；可以据此核对是否办成。

choices.text: The failed payment won’t take my money, right?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Will I be charged for the failed payment attempt?
feedback.explanation: 能表达担心扣款；“Will I be charged?”准确询问是否会产生实际收费，不把失败交易说成会拿走钱的人。

turns.text: No payment has been processed, so you haven’t been charged.

turns.prompt: 关于「预订出现问题」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. I’ll try again with another card. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll try again with another card. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay, I’ll use a different card. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll use a different card. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Perfect. I’ll try the payment again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ll try the payment again.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜找不到预订记录
scenarios.setting: 在“预订出现问题 Booking Problems”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“找不到预订记录”。

turns.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Grand Park Hotel. Do you have a reservation?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. I have a reservation under the name Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I have a reservation under the name Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under the name”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Yes, it should be under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it should be under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Yes. I booked a double room for three nights.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I booked a double room for three nights.
feedback.explanation: “double room”通常指配一张双人床的房间；若对床型有具体要求，还可进一步确认。

choices.text: Yes, my reservation name is Alex Chen.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I have a reservation under the name Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 登记姓名可说“a reservation under the name …”；比“reservation name”更符合查询预订时的惯用说法。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t seem to find a reservation under that name.

turns.prompt: 你想确认办理结果或确认信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s strange. I received a confirmation email.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s strange. I received a confirmation email.
feedback.explanation: “confirmation email”指确认邮件，用来核对办理结果。

choices.text: Are you sure? I have a booking confirmation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you sure? I have a booking confirmation.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I definitely made the reservation. Here’s my confirmation email.

feedback.naturalExpression: I definitely made the reservation. Here’s my confirmation email.
feedback.explanation: “confirmation email”指确认邮件，用来核对办理结果。

choices.text: But I already booked it successfully.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: That’s strange. I received a confirmation email.
feedback.explanation: 这句说明自己确信订成功了；补充已收到的确认邮件，比只强调“成功”更便于工作人员核查。

turns.text: Do you have your confirmation number?

turns.prompt: 你想提供预订编号，帮助前台查询记录，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, it’s 58214. Could you check that number?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it’s 58214. Could you check that number?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Sure. My confirmation number is 58214.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. My confirmation number is 58214.
feedback.explanation: “confirmation number”指确认编号，能帮助工作人员定位记录。

choices.text: Yes. Can you look it up using the confirmation number?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Can you look it up using the confirmation number?
feedback.explanation: “confirmation number”指确认编号，能帮助工作人员定位记录。

choices.text: Yes, can you search this number?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it’s 58214. Could you check that number?
feedback.explanation: 意思清楚；查询编号常说“check / look up this number”，“search”通常还需要说明在哪个系统中搜索。

turns.text: Let me check again… I still can’t find it in our system.

turns.prompt: 你想确认办理结果或确认信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you check the confirmation email? It shows the hotel name and dates.

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check the confirmation email? It shows the hotel name and dates.
feedback.explanation: “confirmation email”指确认邮件，用来核对办理结果。

choices.text: Would it help if I showed you the email?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it help if I showed you the email?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I can show you the booking confirmation on my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can show you the booking confirmation on my phone.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: But the email says I have booked!

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check the confirmation email? It shows the hotel name and dates.
feedback.explanation: 邮件记录可以支持你的说法，但感叹式反驳容易显得着急；出示确认邮件并请对方核对更有帮助。

turns.text: Of course. Let me take a look.
I see the problem. Your reservation was entered under your first name instead of your last name. I’ve found it now.

turns.prompt: 你想确认查到的预订仍然有效，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. So my reservation is still valid?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. So my reservation is still valid?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Perfect. Can you confirm that everything is okay with the booking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Can you confirm that everything is okay with the booking?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: So I can still check in as planned?

feedback.naturalExpression: So I can still check in as planned?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: So my reservation has no problem now?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Great. So my reservation is still valid?
feedback.explanation: 这句能理解，但“has no problem”范围很宽；“still valid”能准确确认预订是否仍有效。

turns.text: Yes. Everything is fine. I apologize for the confusion.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No problem. Thank you for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Thank you for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: That’s all right. Thanks for sorting it out.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s all right. Thanks for sorting it out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great, thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: D｜酒店超售
scenarios.setting: 在“预订出现问题 Booking Problems”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“酒店超售”。

turns.text: Good evening. Welcome to the Grand Park Hotel. May I have your name, please?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi. I have a reservation under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I have a reservation under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: The reservation should be under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: The reservation should be under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Hi, I’m checking in. The name is Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m checking in. The name is Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “checking in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I booked with the name Alex Chen.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I have a reservation under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 这句语法可以接受；“under the name …”是说明预订登记姓名更常见的搭配。

turns.text: Thank you. I found your reservation. Unfortunately, we’ve had an overbooking issue tonight, and your room is no longer available.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: I’m sorry, what do you mean my room isn’t available?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, what do you mean my room isn’t available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: But I have a confirmed reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: But I have a confirmed reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Are you saying the hotel is overbooked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you saying the hotel is overbooked?
feedback.explanation: “overbooked”指超额预订的，即接受的预订超过了实际容量。

choices.text: But you already confirmed my room!

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, what do you mean my room isn’t available?
feedback.explanation: 这句自然地表达不满，并非语法错误；如果希望先弄清情况，可以改成询问为什么房间无法提供。

choices.text: How can my room not available?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, what do you mean my room isn’t available?
feedback.explanation: “available”是形容词，前面需要“be”，例如“How can my room not be available?”。

turns.text: I’m very sorry. We received more reservations than we have rooms available tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想了解酒店超售后能提供什么替代安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: What can you do about my reservation?

feedback.naturalExpression: What can you do about my reservation?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Is there another room you can offer me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another room you can offer me?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What options do I have?

feedback.naturalExpression: What options do I have?
feedback.explanation: “what options”询问可选方案，便于在了解条件后作决定。

choices.text: So where am I supposed to stay tonight?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: What can you do about my reservation?
feedback.explanation: “am I supposed to”在这里带出不满，但问今晚住哪里是合理诉求；可以据此要求具体替代安排。

choices.text: Then what you will do for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: What can you do about my reservation?
feedback.explanation: 直接问句应把“will”放在主语前：“What will you do …?”；询问可行安排比追责式语气更便于协商。

turns.text: We don’t have another room available here, but we’ve arranged a room for you at another hotel nearby.

turns.prompt: 你想了解替代酒店的条件是否合适，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is the other hotel the same standard as this one?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the other hotel the same standard as this one?
feedback.explanation: “same standard”确认大小或标准是否相同，适合在更换方案时核对条件。

choices.text: How far away is the other hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: How far away is the other hotel?
feedback.explanation: “how far”问距离，适合判断地点之间是否方便到达。

choices.text: Will I have to pay anything extra?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I have to pay anything extra?
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: Is that hotel cheaper than here?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is the other hotel the same standard as this one?
feedback.explanation: 这句问的是价格，不是住宿标准；如果在意替代酒店是否等同，应直接核实标准或设施。

turns.text: It’s a similar hotel about five minutes away, and there won’t be any additional charge.

turns.prompt: 你想确认转往其他地点的交通安排，会怎么问？

choices.text: Will you arrange transportation to the other hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will you arrange transportation to the other hotel?
feedback.explanation: “transportation”指交通安排，适合确认如何前往另一个地点。

choices.text: How do I get there?

feedback.naturalExpression: How do I get there?
feedback.explanation: “how do I get”询问到达方法，方便对方提供路线或交通方式。

choices.text: Can you arrange a taxi for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you arrange a taxi for me?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: Do I need to go there by myself?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Will you arrange transportation to the other hotel?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以使用，侧重是否要自行前往；若要确认酒店是否负责交通，直接问是否安排接送更清楚。

turns.text: Yes. We’ll arrange a taxi and cover the cost.

turns.prompt: 关于「预订出现问题」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. In that case, I’ll accept the other hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. In that case, I’ll accept the other hotel.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: Okay. If there’s no extra charge, that works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. If there’s no extra charge, that works for me.
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: All right. Please arrange it for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Please arrange it for me.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I’d rather discuss another solution.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I’d rather discuss another solution.
feedback.explanation: 礼貌表示希望讨论别的方案，保留协商空间，不必立刻接受当前安排。

turns.text: Again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We’ll arrange everything for you.

scenarios.title: E｜到店后没有可用房间
scenarios.setting: 在“预订出现问题 Booking Problems”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“到店后没有可用房间”。

turns.text: Good evening. Welcome to the Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to check in. I have a reservation under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to check in. I have a reservation under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Hi. I’m here to check in. The reservation is under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I’m here to check in. The reservation is under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: I have a room booked under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a room booked under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Hi, I want to do check-in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to check in. I have a reservation under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 办理手续直接用动词短语“check in / check out”，不需要再加“do”；带连字符的形式更常作名词或修饰语。

turns.text: Thank you. I can see your reservation, but unfortunately, we don’t have a room ready for you at the moment.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: I see. How long will I have to wait?

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. How long will I have to wait?
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: When will the room be ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: When will the room be ready?
feedback.explanation: 询问时间或时机，便于对方给出具体安排，减少对等待或操作时间的猜测。

choices.text: Do you know how long it’s going to take?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know how long it’s going to take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: How much time I need to wait?

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. How long will I have to wait?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: I’m afraid we’re not sure. There’s an issue with the room, and it may take several hours.

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否换一个更合适的位置或房间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have another room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have another room available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Could you give me a different room instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you give me a different room instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there any other room I can check into?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any other room I can check into?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Can you change another room for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have another room available?
feedback.explanation: 换房可说“move me to another room / give me another room”；“change another room”容易变成改动另一间房。

turns.text: Let me check… I’m sorry, but we don’t have any other rooms available right now.

turns.prompt: 你想了解没有空房时还有哪些解决方案，会怎么说？

choices.text: What are my options, then?

feedback.naturalExpression: What are my options, then?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Is there anything else you can do?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else you can do?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Could you help me find another hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me find another hotel?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: So what am I supposed to do now?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: What are my options, then?
feedback.explanation: 这句能表达困惑和不满，并要求下一步办法；语气较强，但不应被当作语法错误。

choices.text: Then where I can sleep tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: What are my options, then?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: We can either arrange a room for you at a nearby hotel, or you can wait until your room becomes available.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long do you expect the wait to be?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long do you expect the wait to be?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: If I go to the other hotel, will there be any extra charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: If I go to the other hotel, will there be any extra charge?
feedback.explanation: “extra charge”指额外收费，询问的是原价之外是否还要付钱。

choices.text: What hotel would you move me to?

feedback.naturalExpression: What hotel would you move me to?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Can you guarantee that my room will be ready tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you guarantee that my room will be ready tonight?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

turns.text: We can’t guarantee exactly when your room will be ready. If you’d prefer the other hotel, we’ll cover any difference in price.

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: In that case, I’d prefer the other hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, I’d prefer the other hotel.
feedback.explanation: “in that case”表示根据刚得知的情况调整方案，让前后决定衔接起来。

choices.text: Okay. Could you arrange the other hotel for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you arrange the other hotel for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d rather wait here for a while.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather wait here for a while.
feedback.explanation: “I’d rather”表达更愿意等待，把选择说清楚，也让前台知道暂不换方案。

choices.text: I’d like to speak to the manager first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to speak to the manager first.
feedback.explanation: “first”说明希望先与经理沟通再决定下一步，诉求顺序明确。

choices.text: Then I choose another hotel.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: In that case, I’d prefer the other hotel.
feedback.explanation: 当场作出选择通常说“I’ll choose …”或“I’d prefer …”；单说“I choose”更像陈述固定选择。

turns.text: Of course. I’m very sorry about the inconvenience.
